situation_interpretation.description: What the participant is likely to believe the situation means.

behavioural_strategy.description: Likely action, communication pattern or withdrawal strategy.

relational_objective.description: What the participant is trying to secure, prevent or communicate relationally.

immediate_partner_effect.description: Likely immediate effect on the partner, not a long-term outcome.

predicted_response.description: A concise natural-language prediction of what the participant might say or do.

uncertainty.description: The main uncertainty or plausible alternative supported by the representation.
